tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.drill_module: Bore with a Cannon Drill before installing the mechanism.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.finish_module: Install the mechanism by hand or with a Deployer.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.rapid: Speeds up the small launcher's firing cycle.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.traverse: Speeds up the small launcher's horizontal and vertical aiming drive.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.rapid_detail: Does not shorten the arming cycle.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.traverse_detai: Requires the existing aiming drive; manual aiming is unchanged.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.module_positio: Install an optional module directly in front of the breech; it counts towards length.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.one_module: Only one special module per launcher.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.unfinished: Unfinished component; cannot assemble into a launcher.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.small_descript: Steel small rocket launcher for sustained fire.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.large_descript: Heavy single-shot launcher for large rockets.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.max_length: Maximum total length, including breech and module: %s blocks
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.length_accurac: Longer launchers reduce initial rocket spread.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.matching_struc: Supports one identical launcher on each side, including module and length.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.arming_reset: Disassembly resets readiness; reassembly requires a new arming cycle.
tooltip.cbcatfix.cluster.assembly: Fuzed submunitions around Nitropowder; wire, copper cap and wooden base.
tooltip.cbcatfix.cluster.main_fuze: The main fuze controls when the carrier opens.
tooltip.cbcatfix.cluster.secondary_fuzes: Submunitions use their own configured fuzes, preserved during assembly.
exception.cbcatfix.launcher.length_misma: Launcher lengths differ: main %s blocks, side %s blocks. All connected launchers must have equal length.
exception.cbcatfix.launcher.incompatible: Incompatible side launcher at %s, %s, %s. Use the same rocket size and direction, with aligned breeches.
exception.cbcatfix.launcher.too_many_lau: Too many connected launchers near %s, %s, %s. Maximum: main, one left and one right.
tooltip.cbcatfix.munition.description.ap: Uses mass and impact velocity to penetrate armor.
A light, fast penetrator with improved armor penetration.
A very fast fin-stabilized penetrator optimized for armor.
tooltip.cbcatfix.munition.description.he: Detonates on fuze activation and damages a broad area.
Combines a small explosion with an incendiary effect.
Scatters damaging fragments around the detonation point.
tooltip.cbcatfix.munition.description.fl: Produces an airburst and a wide cone of fragments.
tooltip.cbcatfix.munition.description.sm: Releases a smoke screen at the fuze activation point.
tooltip.cbcatfix.munition.description.he: Creates a frontal blast followed by an armor-piercing shaped-charge jet.
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.accuracy: Rails for zero launch spread: %s (excluding breech)
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.sides: Supports one matching-length launcher on each side
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.above: Large rocket rests above the rail
tooltip.cbcatfix.launcher.loading: Load through the breech by hand or item transport
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.ap: A solid penetrator for armored targets.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.apds: A fast, narrow penetrator carried in a discarding sabot.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.apdsfs: A fin-stabilized penetrator built for armor piercing.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.he: An explosive charge for area damage.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.hei: An explosive round with an incendiary effect.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.hef: A fragmentation charge for exposed targets.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.flak: A bursting charge for engaging aerial targets.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.heat: A shaped charge for defeating armor.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.smoke: A smoke charge for screening an area.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.cluster: A carrier packed with eight fuzed submunitions.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket: A motor-driven carrier for a warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.ap: Strikes armor with a solid projectile, using its momentum to penetrate.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.apds: The subcaliber penetrator concentrates the impact on a small area.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.apdsfs: The fin-stabilized penetrator delivers a concentrated armor-piercing impact.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.he: Detonates to damage nearby targets and terrain.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.hei: Combines blast damage with an incendiary effect.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.hef: Scatters damaging fragments around the burst.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.flak: Bursts into fragments to strike nearby targets.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.heat: Forms a directed jet that penetrates armor ahead of the charge.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.smoke: Releases smoke around the activation point.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.cluster: Releases eight submunitions of the loaded type.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.rocket: The motor accelerates the rocket along its launch direction.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.behavior.propellan: Supplies the motor charge for a rocket of the matching size.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_ap: A rocket carrying an armor-piercing warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_he: A rocket carrying a high-explosive warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_hei: A rocket carrying an explosive-incendiary warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_hef: A rocket carrying a fragmentation warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_fla: A rocket carrying an anti-air fragmentation warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_hea: A rocket carrying a shaped-charge warhead.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_smo: A rocket carrying a smoke charge.
tooltip.cbcatfix.ammo.summary.rocket_roc: A motor-driven carrier for a warhead.
exception.cbcatfix.launcher.too_long: Launcher is too long. Maximum: %s blocks including the breech.
cbcatfix.ponder.small_launcher.text_1: Start with a Cannon Mount. Place the breech in its upper support.
cbcatfix.ponder.small_launcher.text_2: One steel breech and one steel rail form the shortest Small launcher. Face both in the firing direction.
cbcatfix.ponder.small_launcher.text_3: Small launchers can be 2 or 3 blocks long in total, including the breech.
cbcatfix.ponder.small_launcher.text_4: An optional module replaces the rail directly in front of the breech. Use at most one module; it counts towards the length limit.
cbcatfix.ponder.small_launcher.text_5: Rapid Cycling doubles the firing rate. Traverse improves powered aiming instead. Choose the module to suit your installation.
